observations: Window opens 2456.52 (bar 1) and closes 2671.19 (bar 120), +8.7%; window low 2358.62 (bar 63), window high 2850 (bar 97).
Two wide bull trend bars anchor the advance: bar 38 (high 2680, low 2444.19, close 2555.52) and bar 97 (high 2850, low 2658.06, close 2723.15), each closing in the upper half of its range.
Bar 97 closes 126.85 below its 2850 high (long upper tail); subsequent highs step down: 2795 (bar 98), 2804.59 (bar 100), 2786.81 (bar 108), 2727.77 (bar 110).
Major swing lows rise across the window: 2358.62 (bar 63) -> 2568.16 (bar 91) -> 2633.31 (bar 115).
Bar 115 low 2633.31 undercuts bar 110 low 2648.49 by 15.18, then bar 116 closes 2682.25 (bull reversal bar off the low).
The 2700 area was rejected intraday at bars 85 and 95 (both highs 2700) before the 2850 spike; the 2699.53 high (bar 119) restates that resistance.

structures.description: Spike-and-channel bull leg from the bar-63 low 2358.62 to the bar-97 high 2850: a first spike around bar 80 (close 2578.60) and a second spike at bar 97 (close 2723.15), separated by shallow pullbacks with rising swing lows 2358.62 -> 2568.16.

Two-sided trading range since the 2850 spike: highs stopped at 2795 (bar 98), 2804.59 (bar 100) and lower, lows reached 2648.49 (bar 110) and 2633.31 (bar 115); price remains inside this band, roughly 7% below the 2850 high.
Bar 97 is a spike bar (high 2850, low 2658.06, close 2723.15) with a ~126.85-point upper tail and the largest range of the window; a candidate buy-climax/exhaustion bar, not a confirmed reversal.
Tight four-bar cluster (bars 117-120) with overlapping bodies and no directional follow-through, nested in the upper half of the pullback range near 2700 resistance.

evidence_for: Higher major swing lows 2358.62 (bar 63) -> 2568.16 (bar 91) -> 2633.31 (bar 115) keep the window's bull sequence intact at the swing scale.
Two wide bull trend bars (bars 38 and 97) with closes well above their opens show strong bull initiative and follow-through into 2850.
Window closes 2671.19, above the window open 2456.52 and above the 2568.16 higher low; the pullback from 2850 has not broken the prior major higher low.
evidence_against: The 2850 high (bar 97) is a spike with a long upper tail followed by 22 bars without a new high; highs step down to 2727.77 while the lows are two-sided, so the current state is a trading range and 'bull-trend' may be a holdover from earlier in the window.
Bar 115's lower low (2633.31 vs 2648.49 at bar 110) breaks the immediate higher-low sequence inside the pullback, a first sign of weakening bull structure.
The last four bars have small bodies and heavy overlap with no follow-through, which weakens evidence for trend continuation.
transition_conditions: Bull resumption: a trend bar closing above 2699.53 (bar 119 high) and then acceptance above 2804.59 (bar 100 high) with a following bar in the same direction.
Range-to-bear transition: closes below 2633.31 (bar 115 low) and then below 2568.16 (bar 91 low) would break the sequence of higher swing lows.
Breakout resolution of the tight 2660.49-2699.53 cluster (bars 117-120) by a trend bar closing beyond it with follow-through, which would define the next directional push.
